decisions.reason: Approved parity rule: when horizontalId is absent, incoming usePageId supplies the horizontal identity; supplied-ID and derived-ID branches must return the same scoped result.
Approved compatibility rule: accept the extra showArchived client property but ignore it because EngineUseHorizontalInterReqVO does not declare or apply the field.
Approved boundary: return no more than 10000 ordered rows, preserve the unpaged total, and enforce 10 second, 20 MB serialized-response and 40 MB payload-memory offline budgets.
Approved parity rule: preserve custField60040_0|custField59627 verbatim after stable ordering and calculated-field projection.
Approved effect order: REFRESH coordination must complete before list execution; a sync failure prevents the query and remains retryable.
